methods.label: Compare bias and sample size
methods.explanation: Reliable estimation requires randomness and an appropriate sample size. Surveying students outside an eyeglass store or surveying only those who failed a vision screening introduces bias, while a random sample of 200 generally gives a more stable estimate than a random sample of 20. Therefore, choose C.
methods.levelReason: The comparison uses qualitative sampling bias and sample-size reasoning, without advanced statistical formulas.
